messages:
olivia: FYI spotted intermittent egress "ghosting" in eu-west dedicated slices — packets delayed/dropped in 30s bursts. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/egress?range=1h
raj: saw tail latency spike at 08:12 UTC too. same as last-month soft-quarantine?
olivia: nope. last month NVMe. this is nic tx_q len + route flap to egress proxy. net shows tx_q_len spike and flow reprograms.
ben: got tcpdump?
olivia: captured 45s window: drops ~3.7%, retransmits up 12x. snippets:
[08:12:03] nic0 tx_q_len=1024 -> 4096
[08:12:05] route egress-proxy-14 flapped -> fallback
[08:12:08] tcp_retransmits += 47
mina: are these tenants colocated on same slice?
olivia: yes — two heavy tenants on same fractional slice, shared egress VLAN. dedicated GPU but shared egress.
sam: isolation gap: compute carveout != egress carveout. options: carve egress per-slice (costly), per-slice QoS policing (cheaper), route diversity + guard rails.
raj: short term: (QoS policing + route diversity). implement per-slice policing to cap bursts, shift heavy tenants to different egress paths.
ben: add probe: if tx_q spike + path flap then soft-drain noisy tenant for 60s.
olivia: opened INF-7821 https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-7821 assigned to @raj. actions: temp policing 500Mbps on slice, enable path-flap alert, schedule targeted migration.
eng-sre-bot: auto: alert INF-7821 created, assigned raj; will page on next flap >30s.
mina: note: cluster-wide policing ups egress cost ~12%. scope to affected AZs. update docs: "dedicated compute != dedicated egress" for CS/sales.
sam: I'll draft doc blurb and sync w/CS. raj add probe + runbook patch with canary.
raj: will post patch/canary plan in-thread when ready. :thumbsup:
